name: Paluck Technologies Limited
about: Paluck Technologies Limited operates as a diversified service enterprise in India. The company operates through two segments, Automobile and Engineering Services segment and Logistics and Equipment Rental Services segment. The Automobile and Engineering Services segment, includes telecom engineering services, implements and maintains telecom infrastructure for telecom equipment manufacturer (OEMs), base transceiver station (BTS) and optical fiber cable (OFC) maintenance services for a government-owned operator; and Automobile Services, operates as an authorised distributor, dealership, and service centre for multiple prominent original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across the power, commercial vehicle, and two-wheeler; power equipment, provides maintenance and servicing of diesel generating sets, gas engines, dual-fuel generators, and non-fossil fuel generators and sales of genuine spare parts and components; commercial vehicle operates a dedicated authorised service centre, a network of transporters, fleet operators, and logistics hubs; and two-wheeler, operates an authorised dealership and service centre for a renowned automobile manufacturer. The Logistics and Equipment Rental Services segment operate as the construction equipment rental fleets catering to renowned infrastructure giants. It provides end-to-end concrete transportation and supply, equipment rental services for residential, commercial, and public infrastructure projects, and consists a fleet comprising 92 transit mixers, 13 concrete pumps, and 23 Logistics Trucks. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Gurugram, India.
